Sumitomo Life Insurance Co. Sells 2,586 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Dante Gardener | Jan 20th, 2019
Sumitomo Life Insurance Co. reduced its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.5% during the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 169,306 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 2,586 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises about 4.6% of Sumitomo Life Insurance Co.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its largest holding. Sumitomo Life Insurance Co.’s holdings in Apple were worth $38,219,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors also recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Bowling Portfolio Management LLC raised its position in Apple by 1.2% in the third quarter. Bowling Portfolio Management LLC now owns 103,958 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $23,468,000 after acquiring an additional 1,260 shares in the last quarter. IMA Wealth Inc. raised its position in Apple by 1.8% in the third quarter. IMA Wealth Inc. now owns 16,415 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,706,000 after acquiring an additional 286 shares in the last quarter. Aperio Group LLC raised its position in Apple by 1.6% in the third quarter. Aperio Group LLC now owns 3,483,623 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $786,393,000 after acquiring an additional 55,456 shares in the last quarter. Highland Capital Management LLC raised its position in Apple by 2.1% in the third quarter. Highland Capital Management LLC now owns 210,419 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $47,500,000 after acquiring an additional 4,254 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Davis R M Inc. raised its position in Apple by 0.3% in the third quarter. Davis R M Inc. now owns 420,874 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $95,008,000 after acquiring an additional 1,251 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 57.04% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
Several brokerages have commented on AAPL. Morgan Stanley reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $247.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, October 10th. BidaskClub cut shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research report on Wednesday, November 28th. HSBC cut shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $181.37 price target on the stock. in a research report on Sunday, December 9th. Finally, Needham & Company LLC dropped their price target on shares of Apple from $200.00 to $180.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a research report on Thursday, January 3rd. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have given a hold rating and twenty-two have assigned a buy rating to the stock. The company has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $195.74.
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $156.82 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $142.00 and a fifty-two week high of $233.47. The stock has a market cap of $770.79 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 13.21, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.49 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the business posted $2.07 EPS. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. As a group, equities analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 12.1 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . Insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.

About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
